title: How can I make my gas stove function more efficiently?
desc: Using your gas stove more efficiently is one method to save money on gas. While cooking, keep the heat as low as possible, make sure the pot or pan completely covers the flames, and maintain the burners clean so they work correctly. You may also save money by changing up your cookware.

title: What are the features of a good stove?
desc: A good stove will not waste too much fuel and will ensure that we receive the most heat out of the given amount of fuel. It should also have an air supply to sustain burning and allow smoke to leave freely.
